mapper.select: SELECT exclusion_id, company_id, employee_id, attendance_source_id, source_business_key, source_version, oa_attendance_document_id, knowledge_at, reason, created_by, audit_reference, user_confirmation_text, user_confirmation_sha256, evidence_sha256, request_id, reversed_at, reversed_by, reversal_reason, reversal_request_id FROM attendance_report_oa_evidence_exclusion WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND oa_attendance_document_id = #{oaAttendanceDocumentId}

SELECT exclusion_id, company_id, employee_id, attendance_source_id, source_business_key, source_version, oa_attendance_document_id, knowledge_at, reason, created_by, audit_reference, user_confirmation_text, user_confirmation_sha256, evidence_sha256, request_id, reversed_at, reversed_by, reversal_reason, reversal_request_id FROM attendance_report_oa_evidence_exclusion WHERE exclusion_id = #{exclusionId}

SELECT oa.oa_attendance_document_id AS oaAttendanceDocumentId, oa.document_type AS documentType, oa.leave_type AS leaveType, oa.source_status AS sourceStatus, normalized.validation_status AS validationStatus, normalized.interval_start AS intervalStart, normalized.interval_end AS intervalEnd, matched.match_status AS matchStatus, matched.employee_id AS employeeId, employee.company_id AS companyId, employee.employee_number AS employeeNumber FROM oa_attendance_document oa JOIN normalized_attendance_record normalized ON normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id = oa.normalized_attendance_record_id AND normalized.validation_status = 'VALID' JOIN raw_attendance_fact raw ON raw.raw_attendance_fact_id = normalized.raw_attendance_fact_id JOIN employee_match_decision matched ON matched.normalized_attendance_record_id = normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id AND matched.match_status = 'MATCHED' JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = matched.employee_id WHERE oa.oa_attendance_document_id = #{oaAttendanceDocumentId} AND oa.attendance_source_id = #{attendanceSourceId} AND raw.source_business_key = #{sourceBusinessKey} AND oa.source_version = #{sourceVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_report_oa_evidence_exclusion ( exclusion_id, company_id, employee_id, attendance_source_id, source_business_key, source_version, oa_attendance_document_id, knowledge_at, reversed_at, reason, created_by, audit_reference, user_confirmation_text, user_confirmation_sha256, evidence_sha256, request_id, reversed_by, reversal_reason, reversal_request_id ) VALUES ( #{exclusionId}, #{companyId}, #{employeeId}, #{attendanceSourceId}, #{sourceBusinessKey}, #{sourceVersion}, #{oaAttendanceDocumentId}, #{knowledgeAt}, NULL, #{reason}, #{createdBy}, #{auditReference}, #{userConfirmationText}, #{userConfirmationSha256}, #{evidenceSha256}, #{requestId}, NULL, NULL, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT attendance_source_id FROM attendance_source WHERE attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND source_type = 'OA_ATTENDANCE' AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_report_oa_evidence_exclusion SET reversed_at = #{reversedAt}, reversed_by = #{reversedBy}, reversal_reason = #{reversalReason}, reversal_request_id = #{reversalRequestId} WHERE exclusion_id = #{exclusionId} AND reversed_at IS NULL
